title: What if the thing you’re praying for is the very thing God is trying to break off your life?
paragraphs: What if the thing you’re praying for is the very thing God is trying to break off your life?

Sometimes God isn’t punishing you…
He’s protecting you.

He will break the idols you cling to —
the relationships you overvalue,
the achievements you worship,
the desires that quietly replaced Him…

Not to hurt you,
but to heal you.

Because when God removes what you idolize,
He reveals what your soul truly needs.

Let Him rebuild you with His truth.
Let Him reorder your heart.
Let Him be enough — because He always has been. ✨
“Little children, keep yourselves from idols.” — 1 John 5:21 (ESV)
